question: Which country hosted the Sultan of Johor Cup 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malaysia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sultan of Johor Cup is an** annual**, international **under-21 men's field hockey** tournament held in **Malaysia. **
 
• Malaysia is a country in Southeast Asia, lying just north of the Equator.
 
• Malaysia:- Capital: **Kuala Lumpur**; Currency: **Malaysian ringgit**, formerly known as the Malaysian dollar.
 
• **Malaysia** has multiple military exercises with India, including the annual **Harimau Shakti** and the bilateral **Samudra Laksamana.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **India and Great Britain **are the most **successful teams** having won the Johor Cup** three times**.
 
• India won the Johor Cup in** 2013, 2014, 2022** and was runner-up in 2012, 2015, 2018, and 2019.
 
• Neither Cambodia nor Singapore has won the Johor Cup till now.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The** first edition** of the Sultan of Johor Cup was held in** 2011**.
 
• **The 2023 Sultan of Johor Cup:-**
 
 
• It was the **11th edition**, held at the Taman Daya Hockey Stadium in Johor Bahru, Malaysia from 27 October to 4 November 2023.
 
• **Germany won** the 11th Sultan of Johor Cup gold medal by **defeating Australia** 3-1 in the penalty shootout in the final match.
 
• The Indian junior hockey team had to face defeat by 3-6 at the hands of Germany in the semi-finals.
